title: What If Earth Stopped Spinning? 🌍
description:
Earth suddenly stops spinning. What happens next?
The air keeps racing east faster than any hurricane, the oceans slide to the poles, and one giant continent appears around the middle.

What should we stop next? Tell us in the comments.

#shorts #space #science #earth #whatif
facts_checked: Equator moves east at ~1,670 km/h (over 1,600 km/h) -> https://www.esri.com/about/newsroom/arcuser/what-would-happen-if-earth-stopped-spinning (1,667 km/h); https://howthingsfly.si.edu/ask-an-explainer/if-earth-stopped-rotating-its-axis-what-would-happen (1,100 mph)

After a sudden stop the atmosphere keeps moving east at equator speed -> https://howthingsfly.si.edu/ask-an-explainer/if-earth-stopped-rotating-its-axis-what-would-happen ; https://www.livescience.com/what-if-earth-stopped-spinning.html

Strongest hurricane on record ~345 km/h (Patricia, 215 mph) -> https://www.nhc.noaa.gov/news/20160204_pa_PatriciaTCRAnnouncement.pdf ; https://www.wunderground.com/blog/JeffMasters/hurricane-patricias-215-mph-winds-a-warning-shot-across-our-bow.html

Spin makes Earth and its oceans bulge at the equator; without it water moves toward the poles -> https://www.esri.com/about/newsroom/arcuser/what-would-happen-if-earth-stopped-spinning ; https://www.britannica.com/topic/What-Would-Happen-if-Earth-Stopped-Rotating

Result: two polar oceans and one equatorial megacontinent -> https://www.esri.com/about/newsroom/arcuser/what-would-happen-if-earth-stopped-spinning ; https://legacy.geog.ucsb.edu/what-would-happen-if-the-earth-stopped-spinning/

Non-rotating Earth: one day = one year, half a year of daylight then half of night -> https://howthingsfly.si.edu/ask-an-explainer/if-earth-stopped-rotating-its-axis-what-would-happen ; https://www.esri.com/about/newsroom/arcuser/what-would-happen-if-earth-stopped-spinning

No natural force will stop Earth's spin -> https://www.livescience.com/what-if-earth-stopped-spinning.html ; https://howthingsfly.si.edu/ask-an-explainer/if-earth-stopped-rotating-its-axis-what-would-happen

Day lengthens ~1.8 ms per century measured (2.3 ms tidal prediction) -> https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC5247521/ ; https://csmonitor.com/Science/2016/1207/Earth-s-slowing-rotation-revealed-by-ancient-astronomers
